Subject: Next steps: procurement path & SOC2/DPA documents

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet you on the demo earlier. Thanks for walking through Acme's use case — team seemed excited about the latency/cost profile we showed for batch scoring and the dedicated capacity option. Per our discussion, I wanted to summarize next steps and confirm procurement readiness: 

1) Commercial path: do you expect to pay by PO (procurement) or by credit card on file? If PO, please confirm whether purchase orders are processed by Tom/Procurement or if we should expect a downstream SOW/contract review.

2) Security gating: you mentioned SOC 2 and the DPA as gating items. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a standard DPA. I’ve attached our standard SOC2 report and the security questionnaire you sent during the call — I added a couple of preliminary answers. Could you flag any particularly high-priority controls?

3) Marketplace: you asked whether an AWS marketplace listing would speed approval. We do have marketplace options that often help procurement teams — happy to route through that if it helps.

Attachments: [Attachment: acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.pdf (pdf)]

Proposed next steps: If you confirm PO vs card and send the PO template, I’ll loop in our finance team to prepare the purchase order paperwork and our legal team if you expect redlines. I’m cc’ing Aditya for any immediate technical/security clarifications.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick answers from procurement side:

- Commercial path: Acme prefers PO for anything over $10k. Tom (cc’d) owns the PO process and will provide the PO template.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA are must-haves for us. We’ll run the security questionnaire through our InfoSec team; I attached the version with a few notes where we need more details.
- Marketplace: yes — if you have an AWS Marketplace listing, that usually shortens our procurement review. If you can provide a marketplace link or listing ID that would be helpful.

We aim to have procurement sign-off within 2–3 weeks once we have the SOC2 report and a DPA in place. We may have a couple of technical questions about data residency and retention (Acme is subject to internal retention rules).

I’ve attached our PO template. 

Attachments: [Attachment: ACME_PO_Template.pdf (pdf)] [Attachment: acme_security_questionnaire_completed.xlsx (xlsx)]

Regards,
Sarah Jensen
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp

Thanks Sarah — really helpful. I’ve added Dev (cc) to answer the technical/data-residency questions and to confirm marketplace listing details.

Next steps on our side:
- I’ll route the PO template to finance to prepare a draft invoice/purchase order path.
- Legal will prepare our standard DPA and share a DocuSign link.
- Dev/Infra will respond with data residency and retention specifics and confirm where the SOC 2 report is hosted.

For transparency, our typical timeline after handing over SOC2 + DPA is 5–10 business days for finance/legal to complete the paperwork (can be faster if no redlines). If marketplace helps accelerate you, we’ll prioritize that flow.

Marissa

Hi Sarah / Marissa —

Quick answers to the technical/security items you flagged: 

- SOC 2 report: The Redwood SOC 2 Type II report for 2025 is hosted in our secure portal. I’ve attached a PDF export for your procurement/legal team (attached). If your team needs an NDA first, let me know and we can gate the report.
- DPA: We have a standard DPA we typically sign. Legal can send via DocuSign once Sarah confirms the contact for signature.
- Data residency: For hosted (Redwood API) customers, customer data is stored in the region you select; for Acme we can provision US-only region nodes. We retain request logs for 180 days by default; retention can be adjusted under an enterprise contract.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on the AWS Marketplace (Listing ID: rdw-inference-aws-2025). Many customers use marketplace procurement to speed approvals — we can route billing through that if you prefer.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-Report-2025.pdf (pdf)]

If you or procurement have any additional control-level questions from the attached questionnaire, send them over and I’ll add detailed responses.
